messages:
Iris: Quick poll to break up the day — if you could live in any fictional world for exactly one year, where would you go and why? Pick one. 🪄🌌
Sam: Hogwarts — always wanted to know which house I'd be in. plus butterbeer. :raised_hands: 
Jordan: Studio Ghibli world. Quiet afternoons in Totoro's countryside, plus soot sprites are adorable. Would bring extra umbrellas. ☔️
Priya: The Bridge from The Expanse (space politics aside) — microgravity gardening sounds like a fun hobby. Also sci-fi tech.
Noah: Star Trek Federation. Clean energy, universal translators, and free replicators? sign me up. Also curious about holodeck ethics.
Lina: Discworld (Ankh-Morpork) for the chaos, but maybe too chaotic. Also: Nanny Ogg's pubs. 
Sam: @Lina hahah yes but you get to meet Death as a character, that’s a plus.
Iris: These picks are awesome. Tiny follow-up: one thing you'd pack that can't be replicated there (no magic allowed)?
Priya: My camera — gotta document the weird. 
Jordan: A well-broken hiking boot. Ghibli landscapes demand it.
Noah: My grandma's stew recipe written down. Cannot trust replicators with traditions.
Lina: A small notebook for sketches and a pen that actually writes.
Sam: A playlist — music makes any place feel like home.
deploy-bot: Reminder: company-wide deploy scheduled in 45 minutes. :robot_face:
Iris: :joy: good timing, deploy-bot. Thanks everyone — mental vacation ideas officially on file. If anyone wants to continue, drop a short scene you’d want to experience there (one sentence).
